- [USER] User mentioned struggling to find something to eat when dining out with non-vegan friends and asked for tips on dealing with them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for dining out with non-vegan friends:
  1. Suggest a vegan-friendly restaurant.
  2. Speak up and ask for modifications.
  3. Be proactive by checking the menu online or calling ahead.
  4. Suggest sharing vegan dishes.
  5. Bring your own food if necessary.
